method.processes: fresh process for each job; randomized mode order per repetition
method.cpu: wait4 user+system, including waited-for native child; peak RSS is max process RSS, not simultaneous tree sum
method.input: local replay of ESI-shaped JSON plus installed SDE; network/download and fixture generation excluded
method.history: 21 retained completed days; next-day full overlapping response with last-three-day corrections; stable missing-day gaps
method.packaging: gzip level 1 proxy measured separately; not an Actions zstd/network measurement
method.native: Node JSON parse/normalization/binary conversion + C read/aggregate/public JSON; all charged; compiler measured separately
